The '''curriculum committee''' at the [[University of Rudrig/Legends|University of Rudrig]] was responsible for developing the university's curriculum and evaluating its quality and effectiveness to the highest standards. Its duties also involved the examination and renewal of faculty members to maintain the highest standard of education in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]].
